q.t: How many days does a leap year have?
q.e: A leap year has one extra day, 29 February, added to the usual 365.

q.t: How many days are there in February 2025?
q.e: 2025 is not a leap year, so February has its usual 28 days.

q.t: How many days are there in February 2024?
q.e: 2024 is a leap year, so February gets the extra day, 29 February.

q.t: How many hours are there in one day?
q.e: 12 hours from midnight to noon and 12 more from noon to midnight.

q.t: 1 hour = how many minutes?
q.e: The minute hand goes all the way round the clock once — past 60 small marks — in 1 hour.

q.t: Half an hour = how many minutes?
q.e: Half of 60 minutes is 30.

q.t: A quarter of an hour = how many minutes?
q.e: Split 60 minutes into 4 equal parts: 15 each.

q.t: How is 1:00 PM written on a 24-hour digital clock?
q.e: After 12 noon the 24-hour clock keeps counting: 12 + 1 = 13.

q.t: In DD/MM/YYYY form, what date is 04/07/2024?
q.e: DD comes first (day 04), then MM (month 07 = July), then the year.

q.t: 1 July is a Monday. What is the date of the next Monday?
q.e: A week has 7 days, so the same day comes again 7 dates later: 1 + 7 = 8.

q.t: Which is the next leap year after 2024?
q.e: Leap years come every 4 years: 2024 + 4.

q.t: Which leap year came just before 2024?
q.e: Go back 4 years: 2024 − 4.

q.t: How is 3:00 PM written on a 24-hour clock?
q.e: Add 12 to afternoon hours: 3 + 12 = 15.

q.t: What is 20:00 hours in AM/PM time?
q.e: 20 − 12 = 8, and any hour after 12 is PM.

q.t: Raghav leaves home at 8:20 AM and comes back at 8:35 AM. How many minutes was he away?
q.e: From 20 minutes past to 35 minutes past is 35 − 20 = 15 minutes.

q.t: Raghav starts his homework at 10:20 AM and takes 25 minutes. When does he finish?
q.e: 20 minutes + 25 minutes = 45 minutes past 10.

q.t: Muneera starts reading at 4:15 PM and reads for 45 minutes. When does she finish?
q.e: 15 + 45 = 60 minutes, which is a full hour, so it becomes 5:00.

q.t: Three quarters of an hour = how many minutes?
q.e: One quarter is 15 minutes, so three quarters are 15 + 15 + 15.

q.t: 15 July is a Monday. Which day is 22 July?
q.e: 22 is 7 days after 15, and every 7 days the same weekday comes back.

q.t: How is 11:45 PM written on a 24-hour clock?
q.e: It is after noon, so add 12: 11 + 12 = 23.

q.t: Laali was born on 04/07/2014 and Chotu on 04/12/2019. How much older is Laali?
q.e: From 4 July 2014 to 4 July 2019 is 5 years, and from July to December is 5 more months.

q.t: Laali was born on 04/07/2014. On which date does she turn 5?
q.e: Her birthday is 4 July every year; 2014 + 5 = 2019.

q.t: How is 5:20 PM written on a 24-hour clock?
q.e: Afternoon: add 12 to the hour, 5 + 12 = 17; the minutes stay 20.

q.t: A class starts at 9:45 AM and ends at 11:10 AM. How many minutes long is it?
How many hours are there from 6 o’clock in the morning to 6 o’clock in the evening?
q.e: 6 AM → 12 noon is 6 hours, and noon → 6 PM is 6 more.

q.t: Today is Wednesday. What is the day after tomorrow?
q.e: Tomorrow is Thursday, and the day after that is Friday.

q.t: 2 hours = how many minutes?
q.e: Each hour is 60 minutes: 60 + 60.

q.t: How many days are there in July and August together?
q.e: July has 31 days and so does August.

q.t: 15 July is a Monday. July has 31 days. Which day is 15 August?
q.e: 15 July → 15 August is 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days, so move 3 days on from Monday.

q.t: Parv was born on 29 February 2016. How many times will 29 February come after his birth, up to the end of 2028?
q.k: len([y for y in range(2017,2029) if y%4==0])
q.e: 29 February only comes in leap years: 2020, 2024 and 2028.

q.t: School assembly ends at 8:15 AM. Then there are 4 periods of 40 minutes each with no break. When does the 4th period end?
q.e: 4 × 40 = 160 minutes = 2 hours 40 minutes; 8:15 + 2 hours = 10:15, + 40 minutes = 10:55.

q.t: A biscuit packet was made on 10 January 2025 and is safe for 6 months. Until which date is it safe?
q.e: Count 6 months on from January: Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul.

q.t: A train leaves at 21:30 and the journey takes 3 hours 45 minutes. When does it arrive?
q.e: 21:30 + 3 hours = 00:30 (just after midnight), + 45 minutes = 01:15, which is 1:15 AM.

q.t: The doctor sleeps from 10 PM to 5 AM. How many hours does she sleep?
q.e: 10 PM → 12 midnight is 2 hours, and midnight → 5 AM is 5 hours.

q.t: A month has 30 days and its 1st is a Sunday. How many Sundays are in that month?
q.e: The Sundays fall on the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th.

q.t: 1 January 2025 was a Wednesday. January has 31 days. Which day was 1 February 2025?
q.e: 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days, so count 3 days on from Wednesday: Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

q.t: Mini reads for 15 minutes every day for 4 weeks. How many hours does she read in all?
q.e: 4 weeks = 28 days; 28 × 15 minutes = 420 minutes, and every 60 minutes make an hour: 7 hours.

q.t: Meena was born in 2016. Her brother is 7 years older. How old does her brother turn in 2030?
q.e: The brother was born in 2016 − 7 = 2009, and 2030 − 2009 = 21.

q.t: A film starts at 2:45 PM and ends at 5:10 PM. How many minutes long is it?
How many leap years are there from 2001 to 2030?
q.k: len([y for y in range(2001,2031) if y%4==0])
